quest.title: Spike Self-Circulation Report: Experimental Procedure
quest.description: Hosseini has finally figured out how to get the Pursina's Spike into the depths of the mines...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hosseini, are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I think I must be feeling the effects myself. Must've stayed here too long while thinking about how to move the Pursina's Spike towards the Ley Line rupture.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: It's not a big deal though. I've had some rest and I'm much better already.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: At the same time, I've also thought of a solution, it's just that... well, I must say that finding a way to move the Pursina's Spike around is actually not as hard as finding excuses to extend report submission dates.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Since the mud covers the ground, we can make it float just a little by using hot air balloons and transport the Spike that way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, that sounds like a pretty good idea.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: Of course, this will help us solve our dark mud problem to some extent, but in areas where it has blocked up the tunnel, we might still have trouble getting the hot air balloon through.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: And this is without speaking of the monsters that the mud will attract...

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I'm afraid that we'll have to leave such things to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Don't worry! Between Paimon and {NICKNAME}, all these monsters won't even know what hit 'em!

choices.text: Guess you're the star of the show, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? W—Well, Paimon's mostly just cheering you on from the sides, y'know...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Ugh, to think that laughing just a little would make me cough this much... Whatever the case, Tu and Hao are packaging the Pursina's Spike and getting the balloon ready.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: I'd have packaged the Pursina's Spike myself, but the mere effort of standing up for a while was enough to send me into coughing fits.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: How embarrassing... Looks like I'll have to train my body as well as my academic mind in the future.

choices.text: I'll lend you my sword for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}, you're just in time. We're done wrapping this thing up.

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: Guess that dude from Sumeru's explained how we're going to use this hot air balloon?

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Come on, Hosseini's not some "dude from Sumeru," he's here to help us with the dark mud. Couldn't you have a bit more respect?

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: H—Hey, this is just a friendly form of address!

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: Right, whatever. The balloon can be used, and the purification device has also been prepared...

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, if you need the help of the Mining Superstar... *cough* Actually, never mind, I can't really help right now.

dialogues.speaker: Hao
dialogues.text: At least you've got some self-awareness. Go get some rest!

dialogues.speaker: Tu
dialogues.text: *sigh* Whatever the case, if you want to start moving the device, just start the hot air balloon right up.

talks.objective: Activate the hot air balloon and transport the Spike

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: I hope you succeed in transporting the Pursina's Spike.
